[b][u]Official Communication, Islamic Republic of Maqamistan[/u][/b]

In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful, Most Compassionate.

Maqamistan is deeply concerned with recent developments regarding the formation of the so-called "The Free Nations Treaty Organization". Maqamistan views this as neither free, nor a treaty, nor on organization; but a gathering of bandits who prey on the weak. We are deeply saddened to see some of our allies in this so-called "organization" that exists solely to oppress the peoples.

Maqamistan would like to remind that capitalism in essence is incompatible with true democracy, and works only to serve the upper class who opress the populace. Maqamistan calls upon all members of the FNTO to reconsider this historic blunder, and calls upon all nations who respect the value of human life, and stand against the system of Shaytan, that is, capitalism, to monitor the situation closely, and take countermeasures if necessary. President Muhamed Velazquez has issued a call to all peoples of the world, as well as friendly socialist governments, to stands against this monstrosity. Maqamistan reinstates its commitment to the welfare of the peoples, and will not hesitate to combat FNTO imperialism on all fronts and mediums, should that be necessary.

Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Islamic Republic of Maqamistan

[quote=qianxun;60564060][spoiler=long ahh post][b][i]Eccoci qui![/i][/b]

It was the 16th of June, 2026. The summer azure had swept past the clouds of last spring, bringing with it the sweltering heat and overbearing light of the Sun. Under such conditions, the great open sea would be illumined in the beautiful blue of the sky, the rising waves carried only by the mighty winds and the pull of the Sun and Moon. However, over the great horizon, an unsettling grey would slowly enter into the view of the Astanirans, like splotches of silver emanating from a natural landscape, approaching ominously from out of the Argos Strait. The SNS [i]Civitas Dei[/i], pride of the Sanguinian Navy, would sail into the Astaniran area of responsibility together with her missile escorts. Caio Graci, communicating with Democratic forces, would thus proclaim: [i]"Eccoci qui!"[/i] ("Here we are!")

[b]Qianxun-Astanir-Sanguivallis International Command[/b]

With the arrival of the Sanguinian Flotilla, the so-called "united front" of Astanir had added a dense amount of manpower and firepower to its arsenal. With this came its own issues however. What started out as a lonesome Democratic movement under Haru Arono had now grown into a massive, multinational force comprising men from Democratic Astanir, Kuhaw-Astan, Vespuria, Qianxun, and Sanguivallis, all with their own sets of equipment, combat doctrines, and command structures. With the conclusion of talks with the Kuhaw-Astan leaders brokered by the 3rd and 4th Maneuver Armies, the time was now to fully reorganize these disjointed military forces under a singular joint command.

This joint command would be known as the Qianxun-Astanir-Sanguivallis International Command (QASIC), and would formally proclaim itself to be the supreme military power in all of Astanir, boasting numbers upwards of nearly 800,000 men overall thanks to intensive recruitment drives from prisoners of war, local gangs, and the Astaniran soviets and popular committees. When the war began, there was a total of 863 tanks engaged in combat in Astanir. Now, there were upwards of 3,000 tanks of all varieties, the overwhelming majority of them being outdated Isaga-56 medium tanks three-fourths of a century old, with armor and armament that could not possibly work on the modern battlefield, but which remained perfectly serviceable at least in Astanir. It's not like they were lacking on trained crewmen either.

In terms of firepower, QASIC originally began the war just with the original 2,100 artillery systems brought along by the Qianxun Expeditionary Fleet and Pax International forces. By now, this number had almost doubled to 3,900 following the complete abandonment of Isolationist lines during the Race of the South, with QASIC forces seizing a huge arsenal of 152 mm and 122 mm howitzers, 57 mm autocannons, MANPADS, recoilless rifles, and mortars of varying calibers. QASIC also had the unusal distinction of capturing a few dozen airlift-worthy assault guns that were probably supposed to be used by Astaniran paratrooper units until the consolidation of Pax Int'l aerial superiority.

Following the talks held with the Argossians of Kuhaw-Astan, QASIC would determine a comprehensive command structure consisting of four major commands: The QASIC Higher Committee to supervise the entirety of the war, QASICARM to manage the ground campaign, QASICOCEAN for the five fleet forces, and QASICAIR for air force, at the moment mostly dominated by Qianxun air fleets. David Cyriacus, Horano Benir, and Uuki-suk Makoli would be jointly appointed as the three highest-ranking commanders of QASIC, with Cyriacus accepting the role of Supreme Commander of QASIC to coordinate military strategy. Han Shihong, the Minister of Labor, would be appointed the QASIC Chief of Staff.

[b]QASIC summer phase offensive[/b]

Qianxun would indeed have a few satellites to access events taking place on Astanir, not necessarily owned by Qianxun itself but collated as part of an intelligence-sharing agreement with Vespurias's civil space corporations, though these wouldn't be necessary to detect enemy troop movements. FPV drones, reconnaissance aircraft sent from Kuwaklti Air Base and Astan Air Base, never mind the sharp influx of first-hand accounts delivered by Democratic spies operating on the frontlines would effectively telegraph to QASIC forces of exactly what the Isolationists were planning on doing, with Pax Int'l accurately mapping the overall layout of the enemy's military formations. 

In a meeting of the QASIC High Committee, David Cyriacus and the other commanders would swiftly concluded that General Kawai's forces intended to stage a massive central breakthrough aimed at shattering Edwin Roylance's 2nd Maneuver Army, which formed a paper-thin vanguard for 1st and 5th Maneuver Army's recent victories further east. However, the exact capabilities of the Isolationist forces would remain highly suspect, with Cyriacus noting that the Isolationists lacked air power to feasibly coordinate a combined arms offensive of such a scale, nor has their naval forces mustered up either resources or morale to even try to combat the Democrats at sea, leaving them forced to concentrate on an inland campaign.

General Bai He of 5th Maneuver Army would recommend QASIC forces to adopt a strategic counteroffensive strategy, encouraging QASIC artillery teams to bombard Isolationist positions to coerce them into launching their invasion early, after which he and 1st Maneuver Army can launch flanking maneuvers to encircle the entire Isolationist force in one fell swoop. While this proposal would prove somewhat popular among the Qianxun soldiers of QASIC because of its obvious Daijunist parallels, Cyriacus himself would reject the proposal as counterintuitive, believing that the Isolationists might delay or even cancel their invasion plans altogether if goaded into attacking with artillery strikes.

Instead, after several recommendations from Freya Moran and Edwin Roylance, Cyriacus would lay out what he would call the "theory of everything in the Astaniran question", a grand, 750,000-man combined arms offensive along a gigantic frontline, constitued by the entire bulk of QASIC's armed forces, aimed at rapidly overwhelming every single aspect of the Isolationist and Restorationist frontline through sheer oversaturation, rapid breakthroughs, and mass encirclementsin short, a complete emulation of Freya Moran's successful strategy during the Race to the South.

[b]Operation Xuanwu[/b]

After opening up with a ferocious aerial and artillery barrage on Isolationist positions identified in Pax International's maps, Democratic forces would blast through the frontlines in waves. In the south, overlooking Astan, 1st, 2nd, and 5th Maneuver Armies under the general command of Freya Moran would begin a series of deep breakthroughs against the Isolationist forces, supported by Kuhaw-Astan forces guarding their flank in the north and coastal bombardments from the DAS [i]Mazuyong[/i] and DAS [i]Wharai[/i], two [i]Wharai[/i]-class Astaniran cruisers captured from the Astaniran Navy a few weeks ago. 

Coordinating the movements of half a million men would be no easy feat, and QASIC forces would employ a highly complex military strategy. Freya Moran's 1st Maneuver Army was to strike in several lines against the Isolationist center, breaking through in their weakest zones to entrap their built-up forces in massive pockets. Edwin Roylance's 2nd Maneuver Army, intended to support Moran's advance on her northern flank, was then to execute a complicated passage of lines to swiftly replace 1st Maneuver Army, bypassing the encirclement and orchestrating his own headlong offensive to drive the Isolationists deeper and deeper into the west.

Bai He's 5th Maneuver Army, which was to guard Moran's southern flank, would be a secondary advance organized largely to protect Moran's advance and to reap the rewards of QASIC's overwhelming naval superiority, tasked with rapidly conquering the southern coastal regions being bombed out by the QASIC ships.

The operation would begin in the darkest hour of the night, with QASIC forces hoping to take advantage of superior thermal and night vision optics against the poorly equipped Isolationist forces, never mind superior sensors, effective artillery and rocket-fire suppression, and coordination of air and ground surveillance ZTQ-11 light tanks would form the vanguard of the offensive, working hand-in-hand with drone reconaissance to keep accurate data on the Isolationists' movements.

As with most engagements, QASIC's older main battle tanks would be in theory evenly-matched against Astaniran armor. However, superior intelligence and reconaissance would enable QASIC forces to adopt a "shoot and scoot" strategy, with QASIC artillery pieces like PLZ-09 self-propelled howitzers and PGZ-87 rocket system s down fire to break up Isolationist defenses from up to 100 km out. Waves upon waves of CSK-16 jeeps and ZSL-93 Jackal APCs would then speed in, taxiing mechanized infantry divisions to support the advance of QASIC ZTZ-11, ZTZ-65, and ZTZ-91 tanks into the heart of the enemy formations.

[b]Operation Menghuan[/b]

The biggest problem currently facing QASIC forces was the matter of the Restorationists. Unlike Isolationist forces, which were on the verge of total collapse, the Restorationists throughout all this time has remained mostly intact. Operation Julong has been largely confined to a few piecemeal attacks and skirmishes along the border, with pro-junta forces having largely staved off most purely through the sheer density of their fortifications, good infantry discipline, and stable supply lines. That said, Julong had been intentionally designed this way to solely keep the Restorationists from attempting to break through Democratic Astanir's weak northern lines.

With Cyriacus looking to destroy the Isolationists once and for all in the south, QASIC would swiftly announce the conclusion of Operation Julong and the initiate of a new military offensive: Operation Menghuan. Whereas Julong had been a direct advance against the Restorationists' frontlines, Menghuan sought to exploit the collapsing Isolationist forces to instead make a massive breakthrough on the Isolationist northern frontline, then swinging north and smashing into the Restorationists on their weaker underbelly, which Cyriacus surmised was poorly-defended compared to their immediate border with the Democrats.

As 3rd and 6th Maneuver Armies began its lightning-quick sprint into the so-called "Menghuan salient" formed by the Isolationists against the Restorationists, 4th Maneuver Army would also begin a diversionary invasion to drive into the Restorationist frontlines to split their forces in two and to conceal the Menghuan offensive. 

[b]Operation Ruyi[/b]

In the meantime, a lightly-armed force of around a hundred thousand men under PAX official Philip Cruzat would be organized. Officially designated the "New Soviet Army" due to composition being mostly volunteers and part-timers from the Astaniran soviets, Cruzat would be ordered by QASIC to use these fresh soldiers to eliminate the "Ruyi pocket", a small hold-out of Isolationist resistance embedded deep within Democratic territory. Unlike with Operation Tiansheng, Cruzat could not count on superior training and firepower to rapidly eviscerate Isolationist defenses. Instead, organizing his force into several lines, he would simply hope to starve out the defenders, ordering artillery strikes when necessary to target depots and straggling armor, but otherwise he would content himself with hanging back and wait for Operations Xuanwu and Menghuan to achieve results.

As an civil addendum to Operation Ruyi, Cruzat would also start partnering up with CEDC and the Conciliar Guard in Astan to resolve the matter of the Llyndorran flu that was still apparently present within the city. As per Moran's orders, the city had already been divided into zones to coordinate the delivery of aid. Now, those zones that would be detected with the flu would be ordered swiftly quarantined along a network of [i]cordons sanitaires[/i]. Pax International, which had been a fighting force all thsi time, would briefly revert back to its humanitarian front, setting up field hospitals and [i]ad hoc[/i] research labs to determine the wisest course of action to avoid an outbreak in the war-torn city.

[b]QASICOCEAN[/b]

QASICOCEAN, the international command's combined fleet force, was now the largest naval fighting force in Astanir, numbering a total of 85 ships under the control of five separate fleet forces: The Sangunian Shamatine Assault Flotilla, the Qianxun Expeditionary Forces Select Flotilla, the Democratic Home Fleet, the Kuhaw-Astan Coastal Fleet, and the Newly Established Fleet. Such a ragtag grouping of forces, with their own radar equipment, differing armaments, inconsistent fuel sources, and differently trained crew meant that some manner of centralization and training needed to be done to ensure that QSAICOCEAN could reliably confront their main naval opponent: The Daesunic Navy.

The Sanguinian and Qianxun Flotillas would be by far the most technologically advanced and professional trained naval forces in QASIC, with similar overall capabilities to the vessels currently being employed by the Daesunics in their collaboration with UDF forces in the Southern Islands. The Sanguinians in particular under Caio Graci would be meticulously drilled thanks to their nearly month-long voyage across the world, their men eager to fight against the people's enemy. Qianxun forces, on the other hand, would be somewhat exhausted after constant sorties and rotations supporting Operation Haiyan, but would nevertheless remain in good spirits after the one-sided slaughter of their enemy at the Battle of the Yellow Bay.

The biggest drawbacks that QASICOCEAN had to contend with was the native Astaniran forces themselves. The most competent of these forces was the Democratic Home Fleet under Minister Tarak Vali, a green-water naval force mostly made up of missile frigates and PT boats that had been serving with the Democratic side since the beginning of the Astaniran Civil War. By current miltary conventions, the Home Fleet was decently equipped, with modernized missile platforms, good radar, and respectable mobility, though with very pitiful armor and anti-air capabilities. At Vali's own admission, the Home Fleet was to be a largely auxiliary formation, tasked not with direct engagement but with oversaturating enemy defenses through its armaments.

After this came the two newer fleets: The Kuhaw-Astan Coastal Fleet and the Newly Established Fleet, both with their own drawbacks. 

On paper, the Kuhaw-Astan Coastal Fleet was the more modernized of the two formations, comprising Nordiheimian-supplied missile boats supplemented with captured frigates, naval trawlers, and other traditional seacraft. Overall, the Kuhaw-Astan possessed firepower that could realistically combat the Daesunic ships, but weighed down extremely heavily by crew inexperience, a lack of supplies and replenishment, as well as an entrenched, traditionalist admiralty culture. While the Nordiheimian ships are expected to serve in open waters in a supporting role, all other ships of the Kuhaw-Astan fleet are to be relegated to coastal bombardment and supply runs.

Next, the Newly Established Fleet, colloquially known as the "Trophy Fleet" due to being constituted almost entirely by warships captured from the Astaniran National Navy at the conclusion of Operation Haiyan. Created by decree of the CEDC, this Newly Established Fleet would be the largest of the five fleets in the QAISOCEAN alone thanks to its two fast battleships, the [i]Karnoua[/i] and the [i]Luakai[/i], which at around 39,000 tonnes full displacement would be the largest set of direct-combat warships currently fighting for the united front. However, their armaments left much to be desired. The battleships had no CIWS, outdated torpedo tubes, weak armor, and dated boilers. The ships did possess some form of modernization of course, such as newer radar and long-ranged SAM launchers, while its six 380mm guns remain a fearful armament despite its obsolescence.

The most pressing issue faced by the Newly Established Fleet was fuel, of which there was not much. Certainly the incoming oil replenishers from Sanguivallis was more than welcome, it was still just a partial solution for Qianxun's dwindling oil supplies. Xavier Almstedt, the CEO of Almstedt Corporation and [i]de facto[/i] owner of Pax Int'l, would thuse authorize the sale of huge quantities of oil harvested from Tencor's oil rigs at a discounted price, with Tencor ships forming a large "Oil Row" bound for Democratic Astanir to feed the needs of the growing Democratic Navy.

As Oil Row began making its shipments, Almstedt would also approach Lavian companies for access to their novel "smart shell" system with which to improve the capabilities of the Karnoua and Luakai's gigantic 380mm guns. An order of 1,900 shells would be ordered for this specific purpose, which QASIC hopes would be accepted and delivered before the Daesunians attempt any major maneuvers. Else, QASIC may opt to replace the battleships' main batteries with available missile systems, or else transform the vessels into grounded [i]ad hoc[/i] fortresses or semi-sunken breakwaters.

[b]Argos Strait Confrontation[/b]

Admiral Caio Graci, as commander of the most powerful naval task force in QASIC, would be placed in charge of all naval forces aligned with Democratic Astanir. In practice, however, direct contact between Graci and the other QASIC fleets would only be sporadic, with Graci himself allowing Vice Admiral Yun Caibo to prosecute his own naval stratregy to deal with what remained of the Isolationist rump state. For now, the Sanguinians had other issues to deal with.

Daesunian forces were present in Maqamistan and were helping to coordinate the reign of terror of the UDF, a neo-imperialist power seeking to realign Astanir towards an authoritarian social order. Though Caio Graci would initially consider blockading Maqamistan's ports, the QASIC Higher Committee would inform Graci to instead prioritize confronting the Daesunians without direct engagement for now. In this, the Higher Committee hopes to make Daesun the aggressor in the eyes of the world, pulling all of QASIC's geopolitical allies towards its side.

To this end, the [i]Civitas Dei[/i] and [i]Gloriosus[/i] would sail ahead to unload their small amphibious forces in a diversionary landing through "Green Bay" in the west of the Mainland. Meanwhile, the rest of the Sanguinian vessels would begin forming an [i]ad hoc[/i] blockade to prevent the Daesunians from accessing Southwestern Astanir via their Maqami ports, with Caio Graci asking the Argossians to send in their missile boats to serve as an addition layer of force projection.[/spoiler][/quote]

[quote=tallisland;60562952][spoiler=[b]Czerwony Lipiec, Red July[/b]]

Oceanice was by no means an insignificant nation. Infact, it was quite the opposite. It held ties with global powers, maintained a strong standing army, and had a sizeable population of one-hundred-and-seventeen million. One would assume that a nation with this much power behind it, this many people, this much money would atleast be somewhat politically stable.

That one would be wrong.

Political upheavals damn near every six months ensured very entertaining news in Tallisland no matter how frightening neo-fascists seizing power in a foreign ally was. From authoritarian, to republican, to authoritarian, back to "republican" again, Oceanice seemed less like a coherent political machine and more of a political coin flip.

Nevertheless, Oceanice was respected by Tallisland (publicly at least) and Holy President Prisk welcomed the new United States of Oceanic, and it's leadership under Ironvisak Willham. Prisk, always the opportunist, saw potential in the new regime to tie Tallisland toward Oceanic, seeing the United States as a role model for the Tallislandic people to aspire for.

Ultimately, when Willham proposed his idea of global anti-socialism, Prisk was overjoyed: for he could take out two metaphorical birds with one metaphorical stone. An immense emphasis must be placed on the "metaphorical" parts, as it will in reality take many stones to take out the millions of birds standing in Prisk's way to guiding the nation into God's Half-loving Sinner-hating Arms.

Prisk was not an idiot. He knew fully what the Young Tallislandics planned for him and his supporters, of what satanic torture they wished Prisk would endure. Yet, in order to maintain his façade of a Liberal Democrat, he was unable to simply order the Tallislandic military to simply find and kill all of the leaders. Unfortunately, he had signed into law a peace in 2022 which saw the Young Tallislandics lay down their weapons to integrate into the political system, meaning that he couldn't legally terminate any of them.

However, with sufficient evidence, he could terminate opposing parties for being terrorists. The fall of Sanguivallis, and rise of the F.N.T.O would provide an excellent backdrop to begin the termination of Prisk's opposition.

It was to thunderous applause on July 4th when Holy President Prisk and Patriarch Błoński stepped out into the the Saintly Palace field in Osliburne to announce the latest law their Neo-principalists had signed. Prisk declared that he would join his Oceanic allies in their war on Socialism, Błoński continuing further that "Socialism is Szatan's Greatest Weapon." It is here that the two emphasized their intention to halt the spread of Socialism not just in Elseyr, but across Erene, beginning with the outlawing of all Anti-Kryzys parties.

Few in that Osliburne crowd understood how significant of a political upheaval had just occured before their eyes. Within fourty-eight hours, local police had raided every single office belonging to the Radical Party of Tallisland, League of Lusandric Socialists, and Democratic Party of Struggle, these being the largest opposition parties in Tallislandic history, and the raid being the largest political crackdown in Tallislandic history.

He mentioned that they were just Sanguinian agents terrorists striking deep into the Tallislandic political systems. Warrants were placed for Kacper Watts, Kjersti Stennes, and Finley Gallagher for promoting socialistic terrorist sentiment. The Neo-principalist Party rejoiced, declaring July 4th to be Dionizy Day, named for the first Patriarch of Lusandrism, and the founder of Tallislandic democracy. If there's one good thing about autocracies, it's the irony in their actions.

Gallagher peacefully surrendered, being himself a peaceful protester but old friend of Prisk and believing that he would receive minimal punishment for his actions. Stennes and Watts however were core members of the Young Tallisland movement and thus went into hiding, the Democratic Party of Struggle and the Radical Party uniting to riot nationwide to overturn the outlawing of the parties, but with some friendly encouragement from Kjersti Stennes, the riots turned into demands for the resignation of Prisk and his regime: the end of Theocracy.

When the riots became too much for the police to handle, it didn't take long for shots to be exchanged. Young Tallisland militants had begun to use fireworks in Kranowo nad Bridgenay which was mistaken for gunshots by local police, who "returned" fire onto the rioters infront of them. When word spread online, the riots intensified tenfold, turning into violent brawls with local law enforcement and police forces.

Stennes contacted her friends in Gründer Industries, saying that now was when they needed the weaponry. She was determined to end Prisk's regime now, before 2027. Ernest Sporthason agreed, and within a week, the AWN was marching side by side with Young Tallisland protesters, funded by Gründer.

Sporthason would begin to whip his corporate allies to stop selling all products to foreign nations to force Prisk to kneel, to drain him of any foreign support.

Tallisland was renowned for being the oldest Republic on Erene, and today on July the Fourth, the Republic gasped, held it's breath.
